newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Western world nickel offtake strong in Oct -INSG.
newsitem.headline: Western world nickel offtake strong in Oct -INSG.

text.p: Western world nickel consumption remained strong in October, rising to 72,500 tonnes from 70,300 in September, the International Nickel Study Group (INSG) said in its latest bulletin.
Asian offtake edged 1,600 tonnes higher to 28,000 tonnes, reflecting a jump in Japan's consumption to 17,000 from 16,000 tonnes in September and a 300 tonne rise in Taiwanese offtake to 4,500 tonnes.
European consumption remained flat overall at 25,500 tonnes but masked generally slightly weaker offtake offset by a 600 tonne increase in Germany's total to 6,500 tonnes.
Western world primary nickel output was also higher, rising to 57,700 tonnes in October from 55,700 a month earlier.
Output was largely flat but the European figure rose to 14,100 tonnes from 13,300, helped by a 800-tonne jump in Norway's production to 5,500 tonnes.
Australian output was also strong, rising to 7,300 tonnes from 6,500 in September, reaching its highest monthly total of the year. --Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
